name: Salesforce
description: A comprehensive cloud-based CRM platform providing tools for sales, service, marketing, and platform development.

evidence.claim: Salesforce supports OAuth 2.0 for API integration.
Salesforce offers a wide range of APIs including REST, SOAP, and Bulk.
Salesforce has officially introduced support for the Model Context Protocol (MCP).
An official MCP server for Salesforce is available on GitHub under the salesforcecli organization.
Developers can sign up for a free Developer Edition org to build and test integrations.

notes: Salesforce provides a free, permanent 'Developer Edition' org which allows for full API access and testing. It has one of the most mature and extensive API ecosystems in the industry.
